title: TCMS Container Format Configuration v1
description: Schema for container format configuration used to wrap test verification results with rich metadata

project.description: Name of the project being tested

environment.description: Environment in which the tests were executed (optional)

platform.description: Platform information including OS and architecture (optional)

run_id.description: ID of the test run; stamped on every verification result (optional, overridden by --run-id and TCMS_RUN_ID)

build_id.description: Build/software identifier under test; stamped on every verification result (optional, overridden by --build-id and TCMS_BUILD_ID)

tester.description: Person or tool that executed the tests; stamped on every verification result (optional, overridden by --tester and TCMS_TESTER)

executor.description: Information about the executor or CI/CD system running the tests (optional)
